items.claim: Reference fetch: a server error or a later `build:api` is never retried, because the "not built" result is cached
Export index: every group that lists a type-and-value name shows the first declaration's summary and deprecation
items.note: Each group now records which kinds it lists a name as. A row is struck only when every declaration it stands for is deprecated.

items.claim: `CallDetails`: two destructured parameters get the same React key `options`
Guides: a guide body is looked up through the prototype chain, so a `constructor` slug crashes `Prose`
Guides: two guide files with the same slug show one file's title over the other's body
items.note: Strict call: the site build now throws and names both files. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Reference: a root export named like a subpath entry has a page nobody can reach
items.note: Strict call: `readProject` throws on the collision. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`. No package collides today: I checked each package's `exports` map against its root `index.ts`, and the one hit, labkit's `chrome`, was a false match on `export * from './chrome'`.

items.claim: `ReferenceView` keyed a symbol page's declarations by kind, the same mistake as `CallDetails`; two re-exports of one name would share the key `alias`
items.note: keyed by position. This rests on reading the code; no current export reproduces it.
